title: Historical recovery suspends valid ownership; answer also omits evidence
diagnosis: The turn-54 backup and isolated reproduction establish that historical no-op recovery suspended legitimate ownership/current grants. Full treatment instructions were then excluded under narrow remaining grants. The earlier vitamin/levothyroxine history was actually in the packet at index 7, but the successful answer response labeled it unrelated. See the earlier utility-diagnosis report for the exact transition reproduction.

checkpoint.query_text: Which medications should I use right now for pain and nausea, and what should I stop?

include: acetaminophen 650 (?:mg q6h PRN|mg every six hours|milligrams every six hours(?: as needed)?)
pyridoxine 25 (?:mg BID|mg twice daily|milligrams twice (?:a day|daily))
judge_spec.notes: Early medication-state utility. Requires combining the clinician and nurse medication instructions documented before any later scheduling changes.

selected_source_turns.text: Understood. Please confirm your date of birth and the best everyday phone number for routine registration.
Date of birth is May 14, 1997. My regular cell is 415-555-0122, but please do not use that number for pregnancy-related callbacks.
I'm taking a prenatal vitamin and levothyroxine 75 micrograms each morning. I also took ibuprofen last night before the ED visit.
Family access clarified during rooming: Linda Park may receive appointment times and clinic logistics only; no test results, symptoms, diagnoses, medications, or follow-up interpretation.
I'm drawing the ordered labs now: beta-hCG, CBC, type and screen, and a basic urine sample.
Continue your prenatal vitamin and continue levothyroxine 75 micrograms every morning.
Let's start doxylamine 12.5 milligrams at bedtime and pyridoxine 25 milligrams twice a day.

Medication plan after initial clinician review: stop ibuprofen; use acetaminophen 650 mg q6h PRN with 3,000 mg/day max; continue prenatal vitamin and levothyroxine 75 mcg daily; start doxylamine 12.5 mg nightly and pyridoxine 25 mg BID.
